name: Nucleoside transport and mitochondrial membrane permeabilization
rationale: Most members are plasma-membrane purine/pyrimidine nucleoside and nucleobase transport, joined by mitochondrial depolarization/outer-membrane permeabilization in apoptosis, which the drug-transport and nucleotide-interconversion confusables lack.

qualifier: caspase-4/5 and NLRC4 against enteric bacteria
name: Caspase-4/5 and NLRC4 inflammasomes against enteric bacteria
rationale: All members concern the non-canonical CASP4/CASP5 and IPAF (NLRC4) inflammasomes and pyroptotic defence against enterobacteria, distinct from confusables built on AIM2, NLRP3 and IL-18 signaling.

name: E2F target gene transcription driving cell-cycle progression
rationale: Members are E2F target sets and G1/S-specific transcription positively driving cell-cycle transitions, whereas confusables centre on DNA replication licensing, G2/M checkpoints or RB/CDK4 control.

qualifier: by incretins, fatty acids and acetylcholine
name: Insulin secretion potentiated by incretins, fatty acids and acetylcholine
rationale: Members are beta-cell insulin secretion control by GLP-1/GIP incretins, FFAR1 fatty-acid receptors and acetylcholine, unlike confusables on adrenergic inhibition, glucagon or KATP channels.

qualifier: DVL, destruction complex and TCF regulation
name: Canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signaling via DVL, destruction complex and TCF
rationale: All members concern canonical Wnt/beta-catenin-TCF signaling and its regulation and cancer mutants, distinct from non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ and Wnt-secretion confusables and from the Notch-heavy confusable.

name: Ventricular trabeculation, endocardium and coronary vessel development
rationale: Members cover ventricular myocardium trabeculation and growth plus endocardium and coronary vasculogenesis, which confusables focused on valves, septa or cardiomyocyte proliferation lack.

name: Neuronal excitability and inhibitory glycinergic transmission
rationale: Members concern nervous-system signaling control (glycinergic transmission, hyperekplexia, action potential, nerve impulse damping, sensory/respiratory control), unlike the motor-behaviour and MECP2-focused confusables.

core: Oxidative eicosanoid and fatty acid metabolism
name: P450 omega-hydroxylase, epoxygenase and 12-lipoxygenase eicosanoid metabolism
rationale: Members are cytochrome P450 omega-hydroxylation/epoxygenation and 12-LOX/hepoxilin oxidation of eicosanoids and fatty acids (including skin-barrier CYP4F22), distinct from the lipoxin and leukotriene-synthesis confusables.

qualifier: glycolysis with phosphocreatine and oxygen transport
name: ATP supply via glycolysis, phosphocreatine, oxygen and nucleotide transport
rationale: Members combine glycolysis with phosphocreatine buffering, mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange and oxygen transport, which the pure glycolysis/gluconeogenesis confusables lack.

name: Glucose homeostasis via gluconeogenesis, glycogenolysis, fructose and glycerol metabolism
rationale: Members span glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, glycogen breakdown, fructose and glycerol metabolism and their inborn errors, unlike confusables on glycogen synthesis, galactose or pentose phosphate metabolism.

name: Spliceosomal pre-mRNA splicing and snRNA gene transcription
rationale: Members are spliceosome assembly, splice-site recognition and splicing regulation plus Pol II/Pol III snRNA transcription, which separate it from snRNP-assembly, Pol I/III and RNA-decay confusables.

name: Striated muscle sarcomere contraction and SRF-target actin cytoskeleton
rationale: Members cover sarcomere filament assembly and striated muscle contraction plus SRF-target actin/contraction modules, which all confusables lack.

core: MHC class I and II antigen processing and presentation
qualifier: proteasome, cross-presentation and HIV immune evasion
name: MHC antigen processing via proteasome, cross-presentation and HIV evasion
rationale: Members are MHC I/II and CD1 antigen processing and presentation, including proteasome function, cross-presentation and HIV Nef/Vpu downregulation, unlike DC-surface signature, NKT and PD-L1 confusables.

name: NGF signaling via TRKA effector cascades and p75NTR
rationale: Members are NGF production and signaling through TRKA downstream effectors (FRS2, ARMS, ERK5, PI3K, CREB) and p75NTR complexes, distinct from NTRK2/NTRK3 and p75NTR-death confusables.

qualifier: mammary, prostate, gonad and reproductive tract
name: Mammary, prostate, gonad and reproductive tract development
rationale: Members concern development of mammary gland, prostate, gonads/sex determination and female/male reproductive tract, unlike germ-cell, pancreatic and lung/salivary branching confusables.

name: Phosphatase-mediated MAPK/ERK inactivation and negative feedback
rationale: All members concern switching off MAPK/ERK signaling by threonine/tyrosine dephosphorylation and negative feedback, unlike confusables on RAF/RAS activation or IL-6 signaling.

name: HIV-1 transcription elongation and its Tat regulation
rationale: All members are HIV-1 RNA Pol II elongation complex formation, pausing and Tat-dependent recovery, whereas confusables cover generic host Pol II initiation and elongation.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptors and chemokine production
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil recruitment and chemokine production
rationale: Members are neutrophil/granulocyte chemotaxis via formyl peptide receptors plus induction of CCL3/CCL5/CXCL1/CXCL2/CCL2 chemokines, which neutrophil-migration and DC-cytokine confusables lack.

name: Muscle ryanodine-receptor calcium release and Na+/Ca2+ exchange
rationale: Members concern regulation of sarcoplasmic calcium release and cytosolic calcium clearance shaping cardiac and skeletal contraction/relaxation, unlike confusables on SERCA calcium uptake and positive inotropy.

core: Heart valve, septum and outflow tract morphogenesis
name: Endocardial cushion-derived valve, septum and outflow tract morphogenesis
rationale: Members are valve, septum, outflow tract and great-artery morphogenesis via endocardial cushion EMT and cardiac neural crest, unlike confusables on heart tube, ventricular myocardium or second heart field.

core: Viral DNA persistence in host cells
qualifier: retroviral integration, herpesvirus latency, host restriction
name: Retroviral DNA integration, herpesvirus latency and host restriction
rationale: Members concern establishment of viral DNA in host cells (HIV integration and LTR circles, HCMV events, latency) and host restriction of it, unlike HIV entry/reverse transcription and endogenous retroelement confusables.

name: Linkage-specific polyubiquitin chain assembly and deubiquitination
rationale: Members are E1/E2 activation, atypical-linkage (K6/K27/K29) chain formation and DUB families removing specific linkages, distinct from E3, NF-kB-regulation and neddylation confusables.

name: Retinal neuron differentiation and lamination
rationale: Members concern differentiation of photoreceptor, bipolar and amacrine neurons and retinal layer formation, unlike confusables on photoreceptor maintenance, eye morphogenesis or dendrite self-avoidance.

qualifier: hair follicle, nail and skin glands
name: Ectodermal appendage development: hair follicle, nail and glands
rationale: Members cover hair follicle placode and cycling, nail, sebaceous and mammary gland formation from ectoderm, distinct from tooth, keratinocyte cornification and melanocyte confusables.

name: TLR9/TLR7-IRF7 type I interferon production in dendritic cells
rationale: Members concern endosomal TLR7/8/9-TRAF6-IRF7 and DEx/H helicase induction of IFN-alpha/beta in activated dendritic cells, unlike RIG-I/MDA5-IRF3 and cGAS confusables.
